RecordQueueCtl.description: Head and tail indices of one 32-entry record queue of 20-byte RecordSlot entries. In VCU_0159 the instance for receive ring 0 is at 0x20002C2C (util_record_queue_a_ctl) and its slots start at 0x20002C34. Only the two index bytes are used; bytes 1..3 and 5..7 are padding. Both indices are masked with 0x1F, so they run 0..31. The layout is the same in every build that uses the queue (VCU_148 and VCU_14a/14b/14e/14f differ only in the base address, per the queue notes). The index width is probably u8, because the code masks the value with 0xFF before adding one.

fields.name: head
fields.description: Producer index: the next free slot. vcu_rx_ring0_push_record advances it modulo 32 after copying a record in. Equal to tail means empty.

fields.name: tail
fields.description: Consumer index: the oldest unread slot. vcu_rx_ring0_pop_record advances it modulo 32 after copying a record out. The queue is full when tail equals head + 1 modulo 32.
